title: MAIRA-2
core_mech: 相较 MAIRA-1，MAIRA-2 增加多视图/既往/报告上下文，并把报告句子与生成式 bounding-box token 绑定。
core_mech_en: Extends MAIRA-1 with multi-view (AP/PA + lateral), prior study/report longitudinal context, and interleaved quantized bounding-box tokens for grounded reporting.
input_desc: 当前正位/侧位胸片、既往正位胸片与报告、indication、technique、comparison 和任务提示
input_en: Current frontal & lateral CXR, prior CXR, prior report, indication, technique, comparison + task prompt
output_desc: 普通 Findings、逐句关联边界框的 grounded Findings，或短语定位框
output_en: Ungrounded Findings, spatially grounded Findings (linking each clinical sentence to bounding boxes), or phrase grounding

source.title: MAIRA-2
notes: Only public model-card metadata was inspected. No gated files or pretrained weights were downloaded; code, weights and dataset terms must each be respected.
Hugging Face access is gated (auto). Each learner must obtain any required upstream access directly; this repository does not bypass gates.

gaps: The MAIRA-2 image/report grounding and language generation pipeline is not integrated; the published model-card/access terms remain upstream.
